name: Pending Incident
query:
SELECT
IFNULL(email_account, 'NA') AS "Daily Tickets Report - Technology:Data:200",
 
-- 🔵 Open Tickets
SUM(CASE
  WHEN status IN ('New', 'In-Progress') THEN 1 ELSE 0
END) AS "Daily Tickets Report - Open Tickets:Int:120",
 
-- 🟠 Pending Age Wise
SUM(CASE
  WHEN status = 'Pending' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0
END) AS "Pending Tickets Age Wise - >= 1 Day:Int:120",
 
SUM(CASE
  WHEN status = 'Pending' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0
END) AS "Pending Tickets Age Wise - 1 to 3 Days:Int:120",
 
SUM(CASE
  WHEN status = 'Pending' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0
END) AS "Pending Tickets Age Wise - 4 to 6 Days:Int:120",
 
SUM(CASE
  WHEN status = 'Pending' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) > 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0
END) AS "Pending Tickets Age Wise - 6 Days Above:Int:120",
 
SUM(CASE
  WHEN status = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0
END) AS "Total Pending:Int:120"
 
FROM `tabHD Ticket`
 
WHERE
docstatus < 2
AND status NOT IN ('Closed', 'Cancelled')
 
AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR DATE(creation) >= %(from_date)s)
AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR DATE(creation) <= %(to_date)s)
 
GROUP BY IFNULL(email_account, 'NA')
 
UNION ALL
 
SELECT
'Total Tickets',
 
SUM(CASE
  WHEN status IN ('New', 'In-Progress') THEN 1 ELSE 0
END),
 
SUM(CASE
  WHEN status = 'Pending' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0
END),
 
SUM(CASE
  WHEN status = 'Pending' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0
END),
 
SUM(CASE
  WHEN status = 'Pending' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0
END),
 
SUM(CASE
  WHEN status = 'Pending' AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) > 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0
END),
 
SUM(CASE
  WHEN status = 'Pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0
END)
 
FROM `tabHD Ticket`
 
WHERE
docstatus < 2
AND status NOT IN ('Closed', 'Cancelled')
 
AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR DATE(creation) >= %(from_date)s)
AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR DATE(creation) <= %(to_date)s)
report_script:
def execute(filters=None):
 
    if not filters:
        filters = {}
 
    query = """
    SELECT
        email_account AS "Technology:Link/Email Account:200",
        COUNT(*) AS "Open Tickets:Int:120",
 
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS ">= 1 Day:Int:120",
 
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) BETWEEN 1 AND 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS "1 to 3 Days:Int:120",
 
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) BETWEEN 4 AND 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS "3 to 6 Days:Int:120",
 
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), creation) > 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS "6 Days above:Int:120",
 
        COUNT(*) AS "Total Pending:Int:120"
 
    FROM `tabHD Ticket`
 
    WHERE
        docstatus < 2
        AND status NOT IN ('Closed', 'Cancelled')
 
        AND (%(from_date)s IS NULL OR DATE(creation) >= %(from_date)s)
        AND (%(to_date)s IS NULL OR DATE(creation) <= %(to_date)s)
 
    GROUP BY email_account
    ORDER BY email_account
    """
 
    data = frappe.db.sql(query, filters, as_dict=1)
 
    return [], data
